contacts.name: Drew D. Thomas
contacts.title: CEO / Owner
contacts.notes: Key principal and CEO. Family-owned business for 50+ years. Licensed contractor in Ohio and Pennsylvania.

contacts.name: General Inquiries
contacts.title: Business Contact
contacts.notes: Main business email. Serves 8 counties in Ohio and northern Pennsylvania. No subcontractors - all in-house team.

target_buyers.fit_rationale: Family-owned fence contractor celebrating 50+ years serving Northeast Ohio and Northwest Pennsylvania. Offers both commercial and residential fencing. Digital platform would streamline their estimate requests, permit guidance for customers, and project scheduling across their 8-county service area.
target_buyers.outreach_notes: Emphasize multi-county service area efficiency, permit guidance integration for customers, and streamlining estimate requests across their large geographic footprint.

contacts.name: Devon Starcher
contacts.title: Founder / Owner / Lead Foreman
contacts.notes: Founder and Lead Foreman. Started installing fence at age 18. Fully responsible for final installations and customer satisfaction. Family owned and operated with wife Misty.
contacts.source: Company website, BBB, LinkedIn, Star Beacon news article

contacts.name: Misty Starcher
contacts.title: Estimator / Administrator
contacts.notes: Primary customer contact and estimator. Handles measurements, quotes, and customer service. Frequently mentioned in customer reviews for excellent communication.
contacts.source: Company website, BBB profile, customer reviews

target_buyers.fit_rationale: Ashtabula-based fence company specializing in residential privacy fences, custom driveway gates, and repairs. Strong local reputation with excellent customer reviews. Platform would enhance their quote management and customer communication.
target_buyers.outreach_notes: Highlight quote management and customer communication improvements. Mention custom driveway gate capabilities. Reference their excellent reviews and reputation for quality service. Family business angle - husband/wife team.

secondary_targets.fit_rationale: Issues building permits for fence installations in unincorporated areas of Ashtabula County. Fence platform with integrated permit guidance would reduce inquiries and help residents understand zoning requirements before applying.
secondary_targets.outreach_notes: Partnership opportunity for permit integration and zoning requirement lookups.

secondary_targets.fit_rationale: Issues zoning permits required before building permits for fence installations within city limits. Digital fence platform could include municipal zoning requirement lookups to streamline the permit process for residents.
secondary_targets.outreach_notes: Municipal partnership for zoning lookup integration.

research_summary.notes: Both primary targets are family-owned businesses with strong local presence. Thomas Fence is established 50+ years with multi-county reach. Ashtabula Fence Co. is newer (founded ~2021) but has excellent reviews and growing reputation. Both use shared general email addresses rather than individual accounts.
